cards.label: Forty minutes later
cards.text: The police were called by a neighbour and left without much interest. You gave a statement that was technically accurate in every detail that didn't matter. The raider is gone. Your ore is still here.
Archie arrives at seven in the morning with two coffees and the air of a man who expected this.

cards.speaker: You
cards.text: "Yeah. They didn't get anything. I used one of the pearls."

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "Did you now." He looks at you. "Nice."
The first fight outside the chicken shop was brutal and terrifying. This time you won with something you made.

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: Archie looks around. "This place is a liability. One lock, a window that doesn't close. You might as well put a sign up."

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "You need to move. Somewhere with a proper door. That means a deposit, and a deposit means cash. Rent first, obviously. Then the deposit."

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "To make cash, you need to make pearls. To make pearls, you need to know how to handle the vein. I'll line you up some help. Des. Best prospector I know."

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "And as your place is going to be our partnership's HQ, what with you crafting the stock and all, you need better security. I know a bloke who does security installs. Reasonable price, no questions."
"And the vein I promised: it's yours. Time type, in Whitechapel. I'll text you the address. It needs work before it pays; that's where Des'll help."
cards.speaker: Archie

cards.text: He finishes his coffee and leaves before you can thank him. You check your phone. There's a pin location. The vein.

tiers.text: He'd never admit it, but Archie is incredibly relieved to see you standing and well.
There was a tension in Archie's body language and face until he got a good look at you and saw you're ok.

emotion.miss: Archie seems tense. You can't tell if he's annoyed, worried, or constipated.

tiers.text: He's impressed. You're not sure whether it's because you handled the raid, protected the ore, or did it thanks to something YOU crafted.
He's impressed, and smug, like you've proven one of Archie's suspicions.

emotion.miss: No fist bump? No fist bump.
